summary: Possible avalanche burial reported in Current Creek near Berthoud Pass; ~20 GCSAR members, Grand County Sheriff's Office, Grand County EMS, and Flight For Life Colorado Avalanche Deployment Team responded. Transceiver search, avalanche dog, and ski tracks showed the people in the vicinity had left and were not caught. All personnel out by 2:30 pm.
location: Current Creek, 'Postage Stamp' area (~1 mi and 1,000 vertical ft from trailhead), near Berthoud Pass
notes: False alarm with full SAR response; no victims.
